verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents per-request payment gating and facilitator-side OFAC/KYT screening of sanctioned or high-risk wallet addresses. Neither is a merchant control to rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents or agent platforms. The only nearby mention is a PM's stated intention to offer options like 'charging unverified bots' or users who exceed rate limits. That is aspirational, not a documented capability, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
